item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Foster The People Albums
item.description:
Hello everyone,

Could someone please upload these Foster The People albums from Qobuz?
  • Supermodel (2014)
    Qobuz: https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/supermodel-foster-the-people/0886444398190
  • Sacred Hearts Club (2017)
    Qobuz: https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/sacred-hearts-club-foster-the-people/0886446550589
  • Lamb's Wool (with Poolside) (2020)
    Qobuz: https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/l...-foster-the-people-and-poolside/qixih3z0ysasc
I'm looking for the original Qobuz lossless files (FLAC), without any transcoding or vinyl rips.

I would really appreciate it if someone could share any or all of these releases.

Thank you very much in advance!
